Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the burial of pet remains.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the burial of pet remains; adding a new sectionto chapter 68.50 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 68.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 68.50 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A cemetery authority may allow the burial of pet remains in thesame cemetery in which the pet's owner is buried in either: (a) Anestablished and operating area of the cemetery; or (b) a section of thecemetery designated solely for the commingling and burial of petremains and human remains. (2) Pet remains, regardless of their location in a cemetery, mustbe contained within the same plot that an individual purchases or haspurchased for their own burial. (3) The burial of pet remains will be authorized only when acemetery authority has received written authorization from the petowner expressing his or her intentions to be buried with his or her petremains. An individual may provide written authorization under thissubsection to the cemetery authority either at the time of purchasing p. 1 SSB 5063a burial plot or after purchasing a burial plot, but in no case may theauthorization be provided after the person is deceased. (4) Pet remains may be buried in the same plot of an individual'shuman remains prior to the burial of the person, at the same time asthe burial of the person, or after the burial of the person.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 68.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: "Pet remains" means the body of a deceased cat or dog in cremateddisposition.
